source_state: uncommitted shared core ordinary/controlled prompt and sampler admission; native supplied-owner recovery
behavior: Ordinary iterators, borrowed controlled generation and detached continuations share cold admission, prompt binding and sampler construction.
Facade host tokens reach admission before native input; metadata includes complete vector capacity and startup does not advance the controller.
Local admission causes and all-rank rejection survive neutral error translation and prevent later native preparation or model work.
Retained admission survives pending completion and detached driver/parent teardown; fork retention shares the original owner rather than issuing new authority.
MLX supplied request ownership is retained by the existing detached recovery path across pending and failed native work.
Native foreign-execution and mismatched-chunk startup reject before model work; host and supplied-request ordinary/controlled generation produce identical two-token output.
The additional Admission stage preserves existing wire tags and participates in the same bounded all-rank failure/cancellation/retry accounting.
limits: Public MLX startup remains explicitly unbudgeted when no internal admission is supplied. This hook does not construct a complete quote or select a shared native-domain pool.
An already prepared opaque input incurred its input allocation before this constructor; raw-token startup now exposes the admission boundary first.

Media and speculative batch preparation, dynamic constraints, controlled delivery prompt copies, capture, snapshots, materialization, existing residency and externally retained token/score handles still need complete enclosing accounting.
Cloning preparation ownership retains the original charge; it does not pay for independent state copies or authorize an additional run.
The new native parity fixture uses explicit unbudgeted authority. Previous finite-pool handoff fixtures do not establish a complete production estimator.
Managed resource bounds are not total-process/system memory guarantees; no new allocator or released-checkpoint measurements were made.

Native linking emits the existing compact-unwind size warning, and the no-default-feature check reports four warnings for quote helpers awaiting production integration; final required builds and tests succeed.
